prompt: Same topic — "tax deductions" — framed two different ways:

options.label: "Explain what a tax deduction is"
options.content: This is a chat-model job: generate new text that explains a concept. There's nothing to look up or compare — the model predicts token by token to produce an explanation. Output: language.

options.label: "Find my notes about tax deductions"
options.content: This is an embeddings job: convert the query into a vector, then find which of your stored notes have vectors nearby in that space. No new text needs to be generated — this is a similarity search, not a conversation. Output: coordinates, compared by distance.
